w: The small murti of Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored in the presence of Swamishri and thousands of devotees.

The five day 80th Birthday Celebration of Pramukh Swami Maharaj and Mandir Murti Pratishtha Mahotsav festival commenced. Swamishri initiated 21 parshads into the Bhagvat diksha (saffron) and 2 youths into parshad diksha. Pujya Mahant Swami inaugurated a new audio cassette of bhajans on Swamishri - 'Pyaru Pramukh Swami Keru Naam' and a set of ten audio cassette discourses by Swamishri.
In the evening the Municipal Corporation of Anand town honored Swamishri and talked glowingly of Swamishri's socio-spiritual works.

BAPS Tribal Uplift Activities in Sabarkantha District :

From 1982, through the inspiration and efforts of Pramukh Swami Maharaj and sadhus, the BAPS has been performing noteworthy services for the uplift of tribal people in the regions Khedbrahma and Poshina. The services are as follows:
Health services : BAPS Medical vans tours the interior tribal regions and treat 300 patients free of cost per day.

Anti-Addiction : as part of its ongoing de-addiction programs a recently held camp was attended by tribals from 70 villages. Beside giving up addictions they also pledged to become vegetarians by not killing and eating goats and buffaloes.
Watershed Projects : BAPS is performing water conservation and harvesting projects in 12 villages.
Education : Literacy drive, scholarships and distribution of notebooks. Mobile education project through a van that will teach tribal children in interior areas is under planning.

Tribal Women's Uplift : To make them self-supporting they are provided with means to help them grow vegetables and earn a living. Special programs for education and anti-addiction are also held for women.
Relief Works : In times of famine the BAPS has organized cattle camps, fodder distribution, food distribution, etc.
Character Building : Through weekly satsang assemblies, and personal contact the tribals are inspired with moral and spiritual values and pride for Hinduism.
Superstitions and Bad Customs : To abolish superstitions and vices personal contact by volunteers inspires faith in God.
